> **Editorial issues are non-normative.** They do not change the conformance bar, the cryptographic construction, or the wire format. They fix typos, clarify ambiguous prose, repair broken links, or improve readability. Normative changes use the `spec-proposal` template; corrections to a published draft use the `errata` template.
